# KQL

Use this skill whenever writing, debugging, or reviewing KQL.

## Watch for

- dynamic values in `summarize by`, `join on`, and `order by`
- equality-only join constraints
- serialized input for window functions
- large result sets and memory-heavy scans

## Discipline

- Filter early.
- Project only needed columns.
- Keep exploratory queries bounded.
